name: @office/web
description: Office web application shell (OFF-030): the primary web client's APPLICATION SHELL as a typed, deterministic VIEW-MODEL layer — project workspace composition, typed command surfaces, the control-tower surface, and evidence navigation over the event ledger. Pure TypeScript view models + command dispatch + navigation state over the landed contracts and in-memory reference engines: NO UI framework, NO DOM, NO rendering (the host wires rendering later), NO direct database access (structurally database-free: no @office/persistence import anywhere, no SQL, no repositories — verified by the boundary self-gate). Every view model is a deterministic projection of the seeded world's public package surfaces (run-twice identical); commands flow through the landed domain/workflow command surfaces and the @office/client-sync online session (typed Results, rejections become displayable view models, never throws); the control tower is the view over @office/intelligence-exceptions' ranked, evidence-chained portfolio exception set with suggested next actions displayed as SUGGESTIONS only; the A8 gateway is consumed TYPE-ONLY (the shell never constructs one).
